title: Tomato Shorba

ingredients.title: For the Shorba
items: Fresh coriander leaves – chopped, for garnish

instruction.title: Blend the Tomatoes
steps: Wash and roughly chop the ripe tomatoes.
Blend the tomatoes into a smooth puree without adding water.

instruction.title: Temper the Spices
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté until fragrant.

instruction.title: Build the Flavor
steps: Pour the tomato puree into the pan.
Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, and black pepper powder.
Mix well and cook until the spices are evenly incorporated.

instruction.title: Simmer & Season
steps: Add water or vegetable stock and stir well.
Bring the shorba to a gentle simmer.
Cook for about 4–5 minutes to allow the flavors to blend.
Season with salt and adjust the spices to taste.

instruction.title: Finish & Serve
steps: Remove the bay leaf before serving.
Stir in chopped fresh coriander leaves.
Serve hot as a light soup or alongside pulao, jeera rice, or other rice dishes.

chefTips: Tomatoes: Use ripe, flavorful tomatoes for natural sweetness and depth; avoid underripe or excessively sour tomatoes.
Classic style: Traditional tomato shorba does not require cream, keeping the soup light and aromatic.
Richness: For a creamier variation, add a small splash of fresh cream just before serving.
Roasted variation: Roast tomatoes with red pepper and garlic before blending for a deeper, more complex flavor.
Mughlai touch: Add whole spices such as a small piece of cinnamon or a cardamom pod while simmering for additional aromatic depth.
